description: Establishment a Frequency Management and Monitoring System and a Quality of Service and Quality of Experience System for the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21, for the Ministry of Digital Economy and the Department of External Resources to work together with the Asian Development Bank as an international development partner for advancing the 'Digital Transformation Project.' The Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka, a key implementing agency of this project, requires a Frequency Management and Monitoring System and a Quality of Service and Quality of Experience System. The estimated external financing for the purpose has been identified as US$ 9.25 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to procure the ‘Frequency Management and Monitoring System' and the 'Quality of Service and Quality of Experience System' for the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka under the Asian Development Bank-funded Digital Transformation Project, was approved by the Cabinet.
